name: AJILE12: Long-term naturalistic human intracranial neural recordings and pose
description: Fixed a bug in the conversion of long-term naturalistic human intracranial recordings and pose tracking that had filled every eye and heart monitoring channel with the data of the first electrode.
Also made the conversion easier to rerun, adding missing electrode groups and fixing how it read channel labels and listed files.
Resulted in the publication of a total **846 GB** of human electrophysiology and pose data on the NIH data archive.
